name: race_same_waves_both_hollows
description: Tide Race (design 1.3 and 2.1, contract-m6 4): each team plays its own hollow, built from the same map, the seats of team t on hollow t. Both hollows get the same waves on the same ticks of their own clocks: team A calls wave 1 at once, team B waits out its window, and each wave's creeps come in the same order at the same offsets from its own horn. Nothing crosses: a tower on hollow 0 never strikes a creep of hollow 1. Health and windows scale by the hollow's own seats: one each in a 1v1 (15 s, base health), two each in a 2v2 (25 s, twice the health).

steps.msg: this build can play Tide Race

steps.assert: m.race and m.hollows.size() == 2 and m.teams.size() == 2 and m.hollows[1].id == 1 and m.hollows[1].team == 1
steps.msg: two teams, each on a hollow of its own

steps.assert: m.seat(1).team == 0 and m.seat(1).hollow == 0 and m.seat(2).team == 1 and m.seat(2).hollow == 1 and m.hollows[0].seats == PackedInt32Array([1]) and m.hollows[1].seats == PackedInt32Array([2])
steps.msg: seat 1 on hollow 0, seat 2 on hollow 1

steps.assert: m.hollows[0].road.length_um == m.hollows[1].road.length_um and m.hollows[0].countdown_t == 900 and m.hollows[1].countdown_t == 900
steps.msg: the same road; a solo's 15 s window on each
wave 1 on both hollows: the same creeps at the same ticks of their own clocks
team A's horn at once, team B's when its window ran out
hollow 1's creeps walk its own road, at one seat's health
team A's arrow strikes only hollow 0's creeps

steps.assert: [m4.seat(1).team, m4.seat(2).team, m4.seat(3).team, m4.seat(4).team] == [0, 0, 1, 1] and m4.hollows[0].seats == PackedInt32Array([1, 2]) and m4.hollows[1].seats == PackedInt32Array([3, 4])
steps.msg: a 2v2: seats 1 and 2 on hollow 0, 3 and 4 on hollow 1
each hollow's first window is a pair's 25 s
and each scales its creeps' health by its own two seats
